dog.description_text:
Meet Alexa!

Alexa is a sweet, playful girl with a big personality and an even bigger love for her people. She thrives on attention and would happily spend her day by your side, whether that means playing with her favorite toys, soaking up belly rubs, or curling up for a cozy nap in the nearest patch of sunshine.

She's a goofy girl who has a funny little bounce when she gets excited, and while she enjoys a game of fetch, she's not always convinced the ball needs to come back. Her silly antics are sure to keep you smiling.

Alexa's favorite things include peanut butter, cheese, chicken, and just about any treat you have to offer. She also loves being the center of attention and is happiest when she can be close to her favorite people.

If you're looking for a fun, affectionate companion with plenty of personality, Alexa may be the perfect match. She's ready to find a family who will love her for exactly who she is and give her the forever home she deserves.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in fostering or adopting? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
